definition: The Will Smith Eating Spaghetti Benchmark is an informal benchmark within the artificial intelligence community, used to assess the capabilities of generative video models in rendering realistic human actions and facial expressions.
details: Originating from a widely shared AI-generated video in 2023, which depicted an unnaturally animated render of actor Will Smith eating spaghetti, the test has since been used as an informal reference point to demonstrate the capabilities and limitations of AI-generated video content.

explainer.lead: The Will Smith Eating Spaghetti test is an informal benchmark for judging generative video models on realistic human actions and facial expressions. It matters as a widely understood reference point for how far AI video has come.

tiers.eli5: People ask an AI video generator to show Will Smith eating spaghetti, then judge how real it looks.
tiers.practitioner: Researchers use it informally to demo capabilities and limits of video generation rather than as a scored metric. A pitfall is that it is informal: results are judged by eye and are not a rigorous evaluation.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition or metric; it is an informal benchmark originating from a widely shared 2023 AI-generated video. Its known limit is the absence of standardized scoring.

explainer.example: A new video model is prompted to render Will Smith eating spaghetti, and viewers compare the output against earlier, unnaturally animated attempts.
